### Between the Living and the Dead - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/between-the-living-and-the-dead-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-25.html
Passage: Numbers 16:47-48
Points:
- Even after narrowly escaping judgment following Korah's rebellion, the Israelites immediately grumbled again and blamed Moses and Aaron.
- Instead of quitting or retaliating against unfair accusations, Moses and Aaron chose to intercede for the people.
- Aaron acted immediately on Moses' direction, running with his censer directly into the center of the congregation.
- Standing boldly between the living and the dead, Aaron offered incense and made atonement to halt the plague.
- Godly leadership perseveres through criticism and selflessly serves others even in thankless and dangerous circumstances.
